plot_results_from_tsv: run plot.py with a logs.tsv file to generate a terminal plot of episode_return over steps
plot_with_errorbars: run plot.py with the --errorbars flag to display error bars on the generated plot
load_file_smooth_data: use load_file to read a .tsv or .csv file and return smoothed x and y arrays
moving_average_cumsum: use moving_average_cumsum to compute a fast cumulative-sum-based moving average over a numpy array
rolling_xs_ys: use rolling_xs_ys to apply a moving average to paired x and y data with a configurable window size
